estimands.population: the complete frozen 768-scenario retained manifest in SHA-256 scenario order
estimands.delta: average conditional mean of BC_i minus OM_i
estimands.heterogeneity: conditional means may vary arbitrarily by scenario and motif
estimands.cross_scenario_dependence: future outcomes and provider randomness are unavailable to the past filtration

method.name: exact-mixture empirical-Bernstein confidence sequence

source.title: Closed-form empirical Bernstein confidence sequences for scalars and matrices

method.inversion: the r9 analytic, Simpson, and Decimal parity-checked implementation

decision.INCONCLUSIVE_OR_UNDERFUNDED: none of the other complete-data branches
decision.missing_precedence: if missing completions do not certify one identical substantive branch, TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE

missingness.pair_rule: any unresolved transport state in any of the six call positions makes the complete pair missing
missingness.state: at each stream position, key by scaled prefix sum and retain the maximum self-normalizer U; future increments depend only on position and prefix sum and a larger U weakly widens the final interval
missingness.output: minimum lower and maximum upper endpoint over every legal completion
missingness.branch_rule: report a substantive branch only if certified for every legal completion; otherwise TRANSPORT_INCONCLUSIVE
missingness.verification: compare with explicit Cartesian enumeration for small missing sets and a branch-flip witness

operating_characteristics.rng: SHA-256 counter stream frozen by implementation
operating_characteristics.no_assurance_region: exact thresholds, delta transition values, and 0.70 < OM < 0.90

sample_size_selection.reason: answers the registered clear alternatives while honestly leaving a numerical indifference region; no resizing to force near-threshold decisions

cost.accepted_responses: at most scheduled positions and not guaranteed
cost.raw_attempts: may exceed scheduled positions only under the separately frozen retry policy and ceiling

transport_readiness.unit: one complete execution of the exact frozen six-call pair route and retry policy
transport_readiness.failure: any call position lacks one unique route-attested schema-preserving response
transport_readiness.denominator: every launched logical trial, including DNS, connect, authentication, refusal, timeout, ambiguity, and unclassified failures
transport_readiness.assumption: representative independent Bernoulli full-route trials under the frozen route and retry policy
transport_readiness.drift: endpoint, model snapshot, route, auth path, transport setting, or retry-policy drift requires requalification
